symbols.name: vector length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries of the vector $u$, which is the length the transform is taken at.
symbols.quote: Let $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$ be a complex vector of length $q$, where $q$ is the number of entries of $u$.

symbols.name: input vector
symbols.meaning: The complex vector of length $q$ that the transform acts on.
symbols.quote: Let $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$ be a complex vector of length $q$, where $q$ is the number of entries of $u$.

symbols.name: primitive root of unity
symbols.meaning: The primitive $q$-th root of unity $\exp(-2\pi i/q)$, whose powers index the transform.
symbols.quote: Let $\omega=\exp(-2\pi i/q)$ be a [primitive $q$-th root of unity](roots-of-unity.md), so $\omega^q=1$ and no smaller positive power of $\omega$ equals $1$.

symbols.name: transform of u
symbols.meaning: The discrete Fourier transform of $u$, whose $k$-th entry is $\hat u_k$.
symbols.quote: The transform of $u$, written $\hat u$, has entries $\hat u_k$, where $j$ indexes the entries of $u$ and $k$ indexes those of $\hat u$, each from $0$ to $q-1$, given by

symbols.name: input index
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of $u$, running from $0$ to $q-1$.
symbols.quote: The transform of $u$, written $\hat u$, has entries $\hat u_k$, where $j$ indexes the entries of $u$ and $k$ indexes those of $\hat u$, each from $0$ to $q-1$, given by

symbols.name: output index
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of $\hat u$, running from $0$ to $q-1$.
symbols.quote: The transform of $u$, written $\hat u$, has entries $\hat u_k$, where $j$ indexes the entries of $u$ and $k$ indexes those of $\hat u$, each from $0$ to $q-1$, given by

symbols.name: second summation index
symbols.meaning: The index running over the entries of $b$ in the convolution sum and the product display.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be their cyclic convolution, $c_l=\sum_{j+r\equiv l\ (\mathrm{mod}\ q)}a_j b_r$, where $r$ indexes the entries of $b$ and $l$ indexes the entries of $c$.

symbols.name: convolution output index
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of the cyclic convolution $c$, running over the entries of $c$.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be their cyclic convolution, $c_l=\sum_{j+r\equiv l\ (\mathrm{mod}\ q)}a_j b_r$, where $r$ indexes the entries of $b$ and $l$ indexes the entries of $c$.

symbols.name: operation count
symbols.meaning: The number of operations the FFT uses on a vector of length $q$, so $N(q)$ counts them.
symbols.quote: Let $N(q)$ count the operations on length $q$; splitting gives $N(q)=2N(q/2)+O(q)$, which solves to $O(q\log q)$.

relations.quote: It matters because it turns [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) into entrywise products.
